annotations.title: What changed on one site: incidents opened and resolved, code pushes, maintenance, new pages

description: Wraps GET /api/sites/{slug}/events. What changed on one site: incidents opened and resolved, code pushes, maintenance, new pages. Call this to find what changed before a number moved (clicks fell, pages got slower): the site's timeline, newest first, the same events the dashboard draws on its charts. Page through with limit and offset.
name: sites_by_slug_events

before.description: for a change: the value before

incidentKind.description: for incident and resolved events, as in /api/incidents

tone.description: a problem in its severity, or a change
